mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (name, code, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, status, created_at FROM departments WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, code, status, created_at FROM departments ORDER BY name
SELECT id, name, code, status, created_at FROM departments WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY name
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET name = #{name}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
